name: Hostinger
tagline: Web hosting, domains and website building for small sites and businesses.
shortDescription: Web hosting provider offering shared, WordPress and cloud hosting, domains and a website builder.
description: Hostinger is a web hosting company offering shared hosting, WordPress hosting, cloud and VPS hosting, domain registration and a website builder.
It is commonly considered by bloggers, freelancers and small businesses launching their first website.

Hosting prices often differ between the introductory term and renewal. Before buying, check the renewal price, the length of term the advertised price requires and what is included (email, backups, SSL).

pricing.notes: Check both the introductory price and the renewal price, and the contract length the advertised price requires.

keyFeatures.title: Several hosting types
keyFeatures.description: Shared, WordPress, cloud and VPS hosting options for different site sizes.

keyFeatures.title: Domain registration
keyFeatures.description: Register and manage domain names alongside hosting.

keyFeatures.title: Website builder
keyFeatures.description: A builder option for people who prefer not to use WordPress.

keyFeatures.title: Control panel
keyFeatures.description: A custom control panel for managing sites, email and domains.

howItWorks: Choose a hosting type that fits your site (most new blogs start with shared or WordPress hosting).
Pick a plan and term length, checking renewal pricing.
Install WordPress or use the website builder, then publish.
useCases: Hosting a new blog or portfolio
notIdealFor: Anyone who needs a free hosting plan
pros: Covers hosting, domains and site building in one account
Options to scale from shared to cloud or VPS
cons: Introductory and renewal prices can differ significantly — check both
Longer terms may be required for the lowest advertised price

checklist: Time to first byte and page load from US, UK, India and Australia test locations
Renewal price vs introductory price for each plan on the date of checking
What is included: SSL, email, backups, staging
Support response time on a basic technical question

faqs.a: Hostinger's plans are paid. Check the official website for current terms, including any money-back guarantee.

faqs.q: What should I check before buying hosting?
faqs.a: Compare the renewal price, required contract length, backups, email accounts, SSL certificates and support channels — not just the introductory price.
